data_collected.text: Only your name, library card number and email address. No location, contacts, camera or microphone access.

purposes.text: Borrowing e-books, showing current loans and sending due-date reminders. Not used for advertising or profiling.
Optional book recommendations, only if you switch them on.

recipients.text: An email delivery provider, only to send reminders. Data is not sold or shared for marketing.

retention.text: Loan records are deleted 30 days after return; remaining data within 30 days of closing your account.

choices_and_withdrawal.text: Recommendations are off by default and can be switched off in Settings as easily as they were switched on. A grievance officer is named.

unknowns: Which email delivery provider is used.
Whether the app behaves as the notice describes (ConsentGuard cannot check this).

findings.title: Limited data and specific purposes
findings.explanation: The app collects only what borrowing and reminders need and says it does not use borrowing history for advertising or profiling.

quotes.quote: We collect only your name, library card number and email address
We do not use it for advertising or profiling.

findings.recommended_action: No action needed for this point.

findings.title: Recommendations are a separate, optional choice
findings.explanation: Recommendations are off by default, can be switched off at any time, and borrowing works either way.

quotes.quote: This is off by default and you can switch it off at any time; borrowing works the same either way.

findings.recommended_action: Switch recommendations on only if you want suggestions based on your borrowing history.

findings.title: Email provider not named
findings.explanation: The recipient is limited to an email delivery provider for reminders, but the provider is not named.

quotes.quote: We share your email address with our email delivery provider only to send reminders.

findings.recommended_action: If it matters to you, ask which email provider is used.

targeted_questions.question: Which email delivery provider sends reminders?

next_steps.action: Keep recommendations off unless you want them.
